name: Cordless Stick Vacuum Cleaner
description: Lightweight cordless stick vacuum with multi-surface brush roll and HEPA filtration for everyday floors and carpets. Runs up to 50 minutes per charge and converts easily into a handheld vac.

name: True HEPA Air Purifier
description: Three-stage filtration captures 99.97% of airborne dust, pollen, and pet dander in rooms up to 500 sq ft. Features an auto air-quality sensor and whisper-quiet sleep mode.

name: Ultrasonic Cool Mist Humidifier 4.5L
description: Top-fill ultrasonic humidifier delivers up to 36 hours of continuous fine mist to relieve dry indoor air. Includes built-in humidistat control and automatic shut-off when empty.

name: Compact Energy-Star Dehumidifier 30-Pint
description: Removes up to 30 pints of excess moisture per day from basements, laundry rooms, and living spaces. Equipped with a removable reservoir, continuous drain hose option, and washable filter.

name: Digital Air Fryer Oven 6-Quart
description: Rapid 360-degree air circulation crisps meals with up to 85% less oil than traditional frying. Includes 8 one-touch presets and a dishwasher-safe nonstick basket.

name: Stainless Steel Electric Gooseneck Kettle
description: Variable temperature kettle heats water quickly to exact degree settings for coffee, tea, and daily kitchen use. Features a precision pour spout and 60-minute keep-warm function.

name: Countertop Microwave Oven 1.1 Cu Ft
description: 1000-watt countertop microwave with smart sensor reheating, 10 power levels, and a glass turntable. Compact footprint fits easily on apartment and family kitchen counters.

name: Handheld Garment Steamer 1500W
description: Heats up in 25 seconds to smooth wrinkles from shirts, curtains, and upholstery without an ironing board. Features a detachable 300ml water tank and anti-drip steam plate.

name: Ceramic Soleplate Steam Iron
description: Glides smoothly over cotton, linen, and synthetics with a scratch-resistant ceramic soleplate and vertical steam burst. Built-in anti-calc system and three-way auto shut-off ensure safe operation.

name: Programmable Drip Coffee Maker 12-Cup
description: 24-hour programmable coffee maker brews rich batches into a thermal carafe with adjustable brew strength. Includes a reusable mesh filter and mid-brew pause-and-serve feature.

name: High-Speed Countertop Blender 1200W
description: Heavy-duty motor and hardened stainless steel blades crush ice, frozen fruit, and nuts effortlessly. Comes with a 64-ounce BPA-free pitcher and variable pulse controls.

name: 4-Slice Stainless Steel Toaster
description: Extra-wide self-centering slots accommodate thick artisan bread, bagels, and waffles with six browning levels. Dual independent control panels let you toast two settings at once.

name: Smart Wi-Fi Robot Vacuum Cleaner
description: LiDAR navigation maps your home for methodical room-by-room cleaning on hardwood and low-pile rugs. Schedule cleanings via mobile app and automatically return to the charging dock.

name: Oscillating Ceramic Tower Space Heater
description: PTC ceramic heating warms bedrooms and home offices rapidly with wide-angle oscillation and a digital thermostat. Includes tip-over protection, overheat shut-off, and remote control.

name: Quiet DC Motor Standing Pedestal Fan
description: Energy-efficient DC motor delivers strong airflow across 12 speed levels while staying quiet enough for bedrooms. Features adjustable height, horizontal oscillation, and a 12-hour timer.

name: Multi-Use Electric Pressure Cooker 6-Quart
description: Combines pressure cooker, slow cooker, rice cooker, steamer, and sauté pan in one countertop appliance. Features a stainless steel inner pot and 12 built-in safety mechanisms.

name: Portable Countertop Dishwasher
description: Fits up to 6 standard place settings without permanent plumbing by connecting directly to your kitchen faucet. Offers 5 wash cycles including heavy, eco, and rapid wash.

name: Compact Mini Fridge 3.2 Cu Ft
description: Quiet compressor mini refrigerator with adjustable glass shelves, door beverage racks, and a separate chiller compartment. Ideal for home offices, dorms, or extra pantry storage.

name: Single-Zone Induction Cooktop Burner
description: 1800-watt portable induction burner heats cookware directly for fast boiling and precise temperature control. Smooth ceramic glass surface wipes clean in seconds after cooking.

name: Fabric Lint & Sweater Shaver
description: USB-rechargeable fabric shaver safely removes pills, fuzz, and lint from sweaters, blankets, and couches. Includes a protective height spacer and detachable lint collector.
